study_identification_part.si_4_title: Deviations From Normative Functioning Underlying Emotional Episodic Memory Revealed Cross-Scale Neurodiverse Alterations Linked to Affective Symptoms in Distinct Psychiatric Disorders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Two single-site datasets were used: (1) Healthy dataset — 409 healthy controls (HCtrain) recruited from the Center for MRI Research, Peking University; (2) Clinical dataset — 324 individuals (164 HC as HCtest, 56 MDD, 31 BD, 73 SZ) recruited from the Center for Neuroimaging, Peking University Sixth Hospital. Both datasets were acquired on the same scanner model (3T GE Discovery MR750) but at different sites.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The healthy dataset included 409 healthy control (HC) participants (HCtrain group) recruited from the Center for MRI Research, Peking University. The clinical dataset consisted of 324 individuals: 56 individuals with MDD, 31 individuals with BD, 73 individuals with SZ, and 164 HC participants (HCtest group). These participants were recruited from the Center for Neuroimaging, Peking University Sixth Hospital."

answer.SINGLE-SITE (Clinical dataset): normative model validation/testing (HCtest, n=164) and clinical evaluation of patients (MDD n=56, BD n=31, SZ n=73)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The Healthy dataset (HCtrain) was used as the training sample to establish the normative reference using Gaussian process regression. The Clinical dataset served dual purposes: the HCtest group (n=164 HC) was used for replicate validation and external verification of model generalizability, while the patient groups (MDD, BD, SZ) were positioned on normative percentile charts for individualized evaluation of functional deviations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We set the HCtrain group as the training sample to establish the normative reference, and the testing sample that comprised the clinical dataset (HCtest group) was positioned on the normative percentile charts for replicate validation and individualized evaluation."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: One normative model was constructed. The overall healthy control count is 573 (HCtrain=409 + HCtest=164). The training phase used 409 HC from the Healthy dataset (HCtrain). The HCtest group of 164 HC from the Clinical dataset was used for external validation/replicate validation. Internal evaluation used 10-fold cross-validation on HCtrain.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Train-phase (HCtrain, n=409): mean=24.6 years, SD=3.8 years, directly from Table 1. Overall-phase (HCtrain+HCtest, n=573): weighted mean = (409*24.6 + 164*24.6)/573 = 24.60 years. Pooled SD = sqrt(((409-1)*3.8^2 + (164-1)*4.0^2)/(409+164-2)) = sqrt((408*14.44 + 163*16.0)/571) = sqrt((5891.52 + 2608.0)/571) = sqrt(8499.52/571) = sqrt(14.886) = 3.86 ≈ 3.87 years. Min and max are inferred from the inclusion criteria stating age range 18-43 years.
